_about: 1-Propanol (1) + 1,2-Dichloroethane (2): isothermal total pressures at 313.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: V. Gil-Hernandez, P. Garcia-Gimenez, S. Otin, M. Artal, I. Velasco, (Vapor + liquid) equilibria for the binary mixtures (1-propanol + dibromomethane, or + bromochloromethane, or + 1,2-dichloroethane or +1-bromo-2-chloroethane) at T = 313.15 K., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 37 (2005) 7-12
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10, 11. The table number in the article was not checked.
